review: I want to be careful here. I am Mennonite by birth and by conviction, which is rarer than it sounds, and I did not expect a Hanukkah record to hand me my own tradition. "Not By Might, Not By Power." Zechariah 4:6. That verse is the floor of everything I believe about not picking up a weapon, and here it is on an album about the Maccabees, who did pick one up, and the record holds both of those without resolving it. I have been waiting my whole life for someone to hold both of those without resolving it. My uncle was shunned in 2003 and I watched it at eleven and I write to him and do not tell the family. Five stars.
